name: vibecart
description: Agent-native merchant discovery, trusted catalogs, multi-item carts, and Stripe Checkout for AI-built apps.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-native commerce network for AI-built apps
interface.longDescription: Resolve VibeCart network merchants, inspect trusted merchant catalogs, and create trusted multi-item Stripe Checkout sessions. Merchants keep their own Stripe account and fulfillment workflow; VibeCart is not merchant of record and takes no transaction percentage.
defaultPrompt: Resolve a published VibeCart merchant by slug.
Show me the trusted VibeCart catalog.
Explain how to connect a merchant securely.
